sources.title: Ark model list (updated 2026-10-25)
sources.evidence: Exact 260628 Character row lists 128k context, 96k maximum input, 32k maximum answer, thinking, multimodal understanding and tool calling. The older 251128 row has no deep-thinking capability.

sources.title: Ark model release announcements (updated 2026-10-24)
sources.evidence: Lists ByteDance seed-character-251128 as newly released under April 2026; the June 2026 260628 update adds thinking, image/video understanding and tool use to the roleplay model. Neither entry states an exact release day.

sources.title: Doubao Model Service Agreement (effective 2026-09-23)
sources.evidence: Applies to Doubao-series models supplied through Ark; grants restricted nonexclusive, nontransferable, time-limited service rights. Model tuning can be deployed only on Ark. Supports proprietary service classification, not an open-weight license.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card: Agentic Intelligence for Productivity
sources.evidence: Downloaded directly and extracted with pdftotext after web-reader size limit. This later first-party card identifies Pro and Turbo variants; its text does not identify Seed Character or supply Character parameter counts or architecture.

sources.title: Ark model release announcements 2025
sources.evidence: Web-reader access timed out; direct HTML fetch succeeded. Embedded release content contains older doubao-1-5-pro-32k-character and doubao-lite-32k-character IDs, but no seed-character entry. Those differently named predecessor models are not treated as this model.

sources.title: Models.dev Seed Character source record
sources.evidence: Catalog lead uses generic Seed Character name and June 23 date; its 256k context assertion conflicts with the exact-version first-party model list. The catalog cites Seed2.0 and general Ark documentation, rather than an exact Character launch announcement.

name.note: Normalized short display name for Doubao-Seed-Character; provider API revisions are identified separately.

developer.note: Release announcement identifies the provider as ByteDance (字节跳动).

family.note: Seed branding is explicit in both published Character model identifiers.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit release found for the generically named Seed Character product is April 2026 (251128 revision). June is a later 260628 update; June 23 is not established for Character by the inspected primary sources. API suffixes do not establish launch dates.

open_weights.note: Documented as a hosted Doubao service under restricted service rights; no first-party public Character checkpoint or open-weight grant was located.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the Doubao model service terms. No cookbook, SDK or catalog-code license is transferred to the model.

parameters_b.note: No total count in exact-model primary documentation found. Exact-name searches of first-party research, arXiv and ByteDance-Seed repositories and review of the later Seed2.1 card located no Character count; sibling values are not transferred.

active_parameters_b.note: No exact-model active count disclosed in inspected material; no dense/MoE assumption or substitution of total parameters.

architecture.note: No Character architecture disclosed in inspected primary material. Targeted exact-name architecture/training/interpretability research searches found no applicable report. The current Seed2.1 card does not identify Character; its design cannot be transferred.

context_window.note: Official 260628 row states 128k; decimal normalization of the published shorthand, not an independently measured endpoint limit.

modalities.note: 260628 release adds image/video understanding and remains a text-generation model. These capabilities are not attributed to the earlier 251128 revision.

reasoning.note: 260628 explicitly supports thinking; the earlier 251128 revision does not.

tool_call.note: Exact revision is labeled for tool calling; announcement mentions function call/tool use.

description.value: ByteDance Seed model for roleplay and narrative dialogue, with text generation, image and video understanding, thinking, and tool calling in its 260628 revision.
description.note: Factual purpose and capabilities; removes the unspecific claim of consistent conversational behavior.

patch.description: ByteDance Seed model for roleplay and narrative dialogue, with text generation, image and video understanding, thinking, and tool calling in its 260628 revision.
patch.notes: Release month refers to the earliest explicitly documented Seed Character release (251128, April 2026). Capabilities and 128k context describe the later 260628 revision announced in June 2026. API revision suffixes are not launch dates. Total/active parameter counts and architecture remain undisclosed in inspected primary sources.

summary: Corrects context from 256k to first-party 128k and the generic product release to April 2026 at month precision; June 260628 is an upgrade. Confirms that latest revision supports text/image/video input, text output, thinking and tools. Adds proprietary classification and a factual description. Total/active parameters and architecture remain undisclosed; no exact-model research card was located, and the later Seed2.1 card provides no Character disclosure. Current endpoint execution was not tested.
